lines.t: Yeah
Uh
I been sittin’ on my hands, that’s a death seat
While my fam in the streets with no fresh meat
Got the Word in my palm and my chest beat
But I scrolled, stayed cold, let the breath leak
Scrolls on the shelf, heart numb, that’s treason
While my brothers starve out for a real reason
Sisters cry in the night, but I’m sleepin’
Claim “son of God,” but my walk stayed weaken
All this time with the bread and I ain’t share
All this time with the light, I ain’t care
Heard the call, played deaf like I ain’t hear
I been hidin’ from the flame that would strip fear
Get off your hands, boy, bow down, bleed
Die on your pride, then rise and lead
Do the works of your Father, now, no delay
Trumpet out the Word every day, all day
Sword in your chest, let it burn that shell
Heart on fire while you walk through hell
For the King, for the lost, for the bloodline
Hardcore thug with the truth in his war rhyme
Every day, that sword hit my rib cage
Fiery tip through the lies and the old rage
Crack shell on my heart till the core show
Thin mask peel back, let the tears flow
I been choosin’ my comfort, my soft throne
While the block full of souls, feelin’ all alone
He said “go,” but I froze with my own plans
Now I look in the mirror, see a false man
So I drop to my face on this cold floor
Both knees to the ground, say “No more”
“Take my life, burn it down to the coal, Lord
I’m done with the talk, put the steel in my soul, Lord”
